rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(2,28) has only finitely many points of degree 10
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each degree <= 10 on X_1(2,28)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of degree 10 on X_1(2,28), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.discovered_by: M. van Hoeij (quintic curve); F. Najman (degree-10 lift)
points.reference: F. Najman, Torsion of elliptic curves over number fields of degree 10 (2026), https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00234v2, Proposition 3.5.
